comments.value: I don't know why this isn't in the game by default

On the Touch controllers the unused A and X buttons would be great for this. Can you please add this? My friend stopped speaking in VR because of lack of PTT.

As a current workaround I'm using OpenVR-InputEmulator to rebind A&X to press the V keyboard button. But it requires the preview to be focussed and has no PTT capability since it's disabled in VR mode.

Submitted in 2018?
I'm surprised this hasn't been enabled by now.
I would love it if this was a thing
Looks like they added this in Open Beta!

how? doesnt it still need ya to push the "V"-key for PTT? 

...not gonna fly with index controllers or am I misinformed, or are we expected to use non native key2button-mapping tools?

I SO would love to finally rid myself of OVRAS - using it ONLY for the PTT function (mappable to any controller-button via steam-conf)

details: Please add push-to-talk functionality for VR users.
title: Push-to-Talk for VR Mode
